name: dial
title: Dial
description: A slider wound into a ring: one track carries a curl from a straight bar to a ring with its gap at six o'clock, min at seven and max at five. Turning anticlockwise lowers the value. Marks and ticks ride the track; the knob travels to the centre and grows into a knurled disc whose dot faces the value. Drag round or along, wheel, or use the slider keys. Winding runs on the surface spring.
base: none (a div with a role=slider knob)
